name: 红色魔术师

idle.desc: Magician's Red: bird head, fireball in each hand, 2f flicker (40x56)

punch.desc: J1/J2 flame punch: 0 wind-up (fists burning), 1 cross punch with fire trail (64 wide, body x=20)

cast.desc: both hands thrust forward, fire burst (64x56, body x=20)

block.desc: guard: forearms up before the beak, small fire wall rising in front

hurt.desc: recoil: leaning back, arms flung behind

heavy.desc: heavy punch: 0 wind-up, near fist cocked behind the head gathering a big fireball; 1 lunging straight, fireball bursting in front of the fist (fist 27 px ahead of body x=20, 34 px up)

source.call: game.art_stands / game.orig（import assets; assets.load_all(); from engine import sprite; sprite.get('magred.<动作>').frames）；原引擎绘制：engine.sprite.draw(img, 'magred.<动作>', x, y, frame=i, flip=False)

notes: 红色魔术师（Magician's Red），主角团替身·替身。朝向：所有帧默认朝右；朝左请水平翻转（以 pivot 的 x 为轴，见 README）。锚点语义（各动作按自己的锚点对齐到 pivot）：脚点(自定义点)=idle/punch/cast/block/hurt/heavy。替身在场景里通常以 alpha≈0.9 绘制并叠加光环（引擎的 sp.aura），图集里是不透明原图、不含光环。fps 取自源码 define(fps=…) 的建议播放速度（没给的用 6），场景里实际播放速率不统一；kind（loop/oneshot/static）是按帧描述和场景用法人工标注的。
